subject.title: [Feature]: Expose AI model used and usage cost when using openrouter/auto

question: Should OpenClaw add a selected-versus-resolved model and provider-cost metadata contract for `openrouter/auto`, and which runtime/session/footer surfaces should expose it?
rationale: The remaining work crosses provider transport, persisted session metadata, agent runtime text, usage templates, and footer wording, so implementation needs a maintainer-approved product/API contract rather than a narrow footer patch.

options.title: Add metadata contract
options.body: Capture provider response model and provider-cost metadata once at the OpenRouter/OpenAI-compatible boundary and expose it consistently through agent, session/status, transcript, usage-template, and footer surfaces.

options.title: Limit to response footer
options.body: Only show the routed OpenRouter model in reply footers, accepting that agent/runtime/session/status surfaces remain blind or inconsistent.

options.title: Fold into broader observability
options.body: Make the broader resolved-backend-model work canonical only if it explicitly covers OpenRouter auto footer and cost display semantics.

recommendation.title: Add metadata contract
recommendation.body: Capture provider response model and provider-cost metadata once at the OpenRouter/OpenAI-compatible boundary and expose it consistently through agent, session/status, transcript, usage-template, and footer surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current-history owner signal for the OpenRouter/provider-runtime product contract and related issue review context.
